A '''Fixer''' was a rank in the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Fixers were technical agents adept at [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]], engineering and biomechanics. Fixers often processed and made sense of technical data (such as [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] and bioscans) gathered by [[Cipher Agent]]s.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
